cpi.note: CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted (BLS series CUUR0000SA0), fetched through FRED because the BLS download host rejects automated clients. October 2025 was never published.

gaps.reason: BLS Consumer Expenditure tables are published only through bls.gov, which rejects automated downloads, so no reviewed, reproducible extract exists yet. Needs a maintainer-downloaded workbook and definition review (consumer unit vs household, total expenditure vs category sum).
CE reports consumer units, not people; no individual-level age spending benchmark was identified.

SIPP publishes asset ownership by household and by householder age only. The single-person-household rows use different age bands and a different population, so they are not used as an all-person benchmark.
Same as individual investments: only household-level SIPP asset tables are published by age.
Same as individual investments: only household-level SIPP debt tables are published by age.
